title: unsubscribe — input
description: Input schema for the SOX unsubscribe operation. Removes channel subscriptions matching the provided channel names or glob patterns. Uses the same pattern syntax as the subscribe operation. Queued-but-unread messages for the removed subscriptions are discarded from the calling agent's mailbox. Normative reference: spec/primitives/channels.md §3.

channels.description: Channel names or glob patterns to unsubscribe from. Supports the same two forms as subscribe.input: (1) Exact match — full channel name. (2) Glob — pattern with '*' wildcards using Unix glob rules. Pattern matching is case-sensitive. Each entry is matched against the agent's current subscriptions; non-matching entries are silently ignored.
